title: The Phoenician Colonies & Carthage
subtitle: c. 1000 – 29 BC · the sea road from Tyre to the Atlantic, and the city that ruled it
testing: We are testing these features and looking to develop them.

record: Excavations at Tyre, Kition, Kommos, Carthage, Gades (Cádiz), Nora, Motya, Sa Caleta / Ebusus, Mogador
tradition: Pliny, Natural History 16.216: Utica's temple of 1178 years

missing: the island city of Tyre from the sea
the temple of Melqart at Gades
the cothon harbours seen from the sea at their height
